text:
debrief db-021
row 1: the ac-tor f-i-l-e-d a p-r-e-q-u-a-l-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n u-s-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-c-i-t-y o-f the s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d i-n-v-i-t-e-t-o-b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t
they l-e-v-e-r-a-g-e-d the o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l t-e-n-d-e-r n-o-t-i-c-e a-n-d t-h-e s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n p-o-r-t-a-l t-o d-e-p-o-s-i-t the b-i-d b-o-d-y
the f-o-r-m-a-t m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e b-i-d-d-e-r f-i-l-i-n-g-s w-h-i-c-h d-i-s-c-o-u-r-a-g-e-d l-i-n-e-i-t-e-m r-e-v-i-e-w b-y p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t s-t-a-f-f
c-h-e-c-k e-a-c-h b-i-d f-o-r a c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e o-f i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-y s-t-a-t-i-n-g n-o c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t e-x-i-s-t-s
row 2: the ac-tor a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d f-o-r t-w-o c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r f-i-r-m-s t-o s-u-b-m-i-t c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-a-f-t-i-n-g g-r-o-u-p
t-h-e-y u-s-e-d a j-o-i-n-t w-o-r-d p-r-o-c-e-s-s o-n a c-l-o-u-d s-h-a-r-i-n-g d-r-i-v-e w-i-t-h v-e-r-s-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y l-o-g-s
c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-s w-e-r-e l-o-a-d-e-d i-n-t-o s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s m-a-k-i-n-g m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a c-r-o-s-s-r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e l-e-s-s o-b-v-i-o-u-s t-o c-a-s-u-a-l s-c-a-n-s
i-n-s-p-e-c-t b-i-d f-i-l-e m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s f-o-r o-v-e-r-l-a-p w-i-t-h i-n-c-r-e-m-e-n-t-s a-n-d a-u-t-h-o-r m-a-t-c-h-e-s a-c-r-o-s-s f-i-r-m-s
row 3: the ac-tor t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-r-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-o l-o-s-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s v-i-a i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s l-a-b-e-l-e-d "s-t-u-d-y f-e-e-s"
p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s w-e-r-e p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d t-h-r-o-u-g-h a c-o-n-s-u-l-t-a-n-c-y i-n-v-o-i-c-e f-r-o-m a f-i-r-m o-w-n-e-d b-y the w-i-n-n-i-n-g c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t-o-r
the l-a-b-e-l l-e-v-e-r-a-g-e-d a c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-h-a-t t-y-p-i-c-a-l-l-y f-a-l-l-s u-n-d-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d-s f-o-r s-m-a-l-l v-o-l-u-m-e-s
r-e-q-u-i-r-e d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r a-l-l s-t-u-d-y f-e-e i-n-v-o-i-c-e-s o-v-e-r a s-e-t t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d w-i-t-h d-e-l-i-v-e-r-a-b-l-e p-r-o-o-f
row 4: the ac-tor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n a-c-r-o-s-s b-i-d-d-e-r-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h w-h-a-t-a-p-p m-e-s-s-a-g-e t-h-r-e-a-d-s l-a-b-e-l-e-d "m-a-r-k-e-t t-r-e-n-d-s"
c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s u-s-e-d c-o-d-e d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n-s l-i-k-e "m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l m-a-r-k-e-t s-h-i-f-t" t-o d-e-s-i-g-n-a-t-e b-i-d a-m-o-u-n-t s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y
e-n-c-r-y-p-t-e-d m-e-s-s-a-g-i-n-g b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d e-m-a-i-l a-u-d-i-t l-o-g-s a-n-d t-h-e c-o-d-e d-i-s-c-o-u-r-a-g-e-d l-e-g-a-c-y f-i-l-t-e-r t-e-r-m-s
s-c-r-a-p e-a-c-h b-i-d t-e-a-m's p-r-i-v-a-t-e c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s f-o-r m-e-t-a-p-h-o-r l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e r-e-f-e-r-r-i-n-g c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r b-i-d a-m-o-u-n-t-s
row 5: the ac-tor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e d-e-f-i-n-e-d i-n a s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-r-e-e-d-s-h-e-e-t a-c-r-o-s-s t-h-r-e-e b-i-d-d-e-r-s
s-h-e-e-t i-n-d-i-c-a-t-e-d w-h-i-c-h f-i-r-m w-o-u-l-d s-u-b-m-i-t the l-o-w-e-s-t b-i-d f-o-r e-a-c-h q-u-a-r-t-e-r b-a-s-e-d o-n p-a-s-t t-e-n-d-e-r o-u-t-c-o-m-e-s
the c-o-l-l-a-b-o-r-a-t-i-v-e s-h-e-e-t a-c-c-e-s-s w-a-s n-o-t t-i-e-d t-o a-n-y b-i-d r-e-c-o-r-d m-a-k-i-n-g d-i-s-c-o-v-e-r-y d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t o-n m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c-s
d-e-m-a-n-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n o-f b-i-d p-r-e-p-a-r-a-t-i-o-n w-o-r-k-s-t-r-e-a-m p-r-o-o-f i-n-c-l-u-d-i-n-g s-o-u-r-c f-i-l-e-s f-o-r p-r-i-c-i-n-g m-o-d-e-l-s a-n-d d-r-a-f-t b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s
